title: Gambit component diagram
description: Gambit, 3D chess for the browser. Unlike the other games it has no TypeScript engine or high-score table: the client is a Godot 4 project exported to WebAssembly, a small TypeScript bridge runs in the page around it (Stockfish included), and its own Worker handles sign-in, invitations, online games with a Durable Object per game, contacts and history. The Worker and the TypeScript tests share the API types and chess.js rules in shared/.

components.name: Gambit
components.responsibility: One game: the Godot client, its page bridge, the shared TypeScript and the Worker, built by build.mjs and deployed together with wrangler.

components.name: Godot client
components.responsibility: The game itself: the 3D table and pieces, the screens, games online, against the computer and in replay, and the client of the Worker's API.

components.name: Page bridge
components.responsibility: TypeScript in the page around the Godot export: boots the engine with a loading screen, runs Stockfish in a Web Worker, and exposes window.chessBridge (navigation, the invitation in the address, the title, the clipboard).

components.name: Shared protocol and rules
components.responsibility: The API's types and the server's chess rules (chess.js), shared by the Worker and the TypeScript tests.

components.name: Chess Worker
components.responsibility: Static assets (joining the split engine .wasm), the page behind icelander.net's sign-in (through the login service), the JSON API, and the GameRoom Durable Object that checks and broadcasts every online action.

components.name: D1 database chess
components.responsibility: Gambit's own record of each player (users, keyed by address), challenges, games with their transcripts (game_events) and contacts.

components.name: Profile picture hosts
components.responsibility: Google's and GitHub's image hosts, the only places players' profile pictures are fetched from.

components.name: Resend
components.responsibility: Sends invitation emails, when RESEND_API_KEY and MAIL_FROM are set.

components.name: icelander.net login service
components.responsibility: Who is signed in to icelander.net (Google or GitHub, verified addresses, name, picture) and their games: roles, asked through a service binding.

relationships.description: Bundled into the Worker and the tests.
In the browser, calls window.chessBridge through JavaScriptBridge (scripts/api.gd): base URL, sign-in navigation, invitation, title, clipboard and Stockfish moves.
HTTP under api/ and auth/, and the WebSocket api/games/{id}/live for online games.
Types, BASE, email and name cleaning, LEVELS, and replay/boardOutcome to judge moves.
Fetches profile pictures for api/avatar/{id}, only from these hosts.
POST /emails for an invitation, best effort.
Service binding ACCOUNTS, through vendor/icelander-auth: who is signed in, on every request to the page and the API.
